description: The figure is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating model performance metrics for three methods—DIN-SQL (zero-shot), TA-SQL (zero-shot), and DIN-SQL (few-shot)—across three evaluation categories. The horizontal axis contains the metric categories, shown left to right as Recall, (an unlabeled middle category), and F1 Score; the vertical axis is a numeric scale with labeled ticks at 40, 60, 80, and 100 on a linear scale (no explicit y-axis title or units are shown). Each category contains three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend: DIN-SQL (zero-shot) in light blue, TA-SQL (zero-shot) in darker blue, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) in light green, with values printed above each bar. For Recall, the bars read 63.58 (light blue), 71.90 (dark blue), and 72.29 (light green). In the unlabeled middle category, the bars read 88.89 (light blue), 91.24 (dark blue), and 92.31 (light green). For F1 Score, the bars read 75.34 (light blue), 80.40 (dark blue), and 81.08 (light green). The bars are not presented as stacked, and there is no visible sorting beyond the fixed left-to-right category order; no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the color coding and numeric annotations.
